Any state of no mind, or the cessation of thought, comes from a weakening of desire, and from you not wanting to think anything (as opposed to ignoring or blocking thought).

The type of meditation I teach we simply call systematic meditation, we go through the different layers of the mind/body/subtle/self one by one, from the outside in! Once you're at the point where all you have to deal with is uncontrolled thought, you shouldn't give attention to them or try to fight them back in any way.
